t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a warm limestone page with a hairline top rule and a vertical margin rule carrying a small rotated label. A large light-weight sans headline in sentence case. Left 60%: a four-column table with mono uppercase headers, hairline rules, numbered rows and small mono codes under each name for <CONTENT>. Right 40%: a large isometric technical line drawing of white process equipment, tanks, filter housings and pipework on a base plate, navy hairlines with steel-blue double-line pipes, no shading, bleeding off the right and bottom edges.
signature_idea: An inspector-by-inspector evidence table set against a large isometric PP plant drawing that bleeds off the page like a catalogue plate.
strengths: bleeding isometric plant gives scale and equipment context without clutter
mono headers and codes with light headline are the brand pairing
steel-blue pipe runs are the single accent
weaknesses: drawing and table do not link; no row points into the plant
invented clause codes and limits would be mistaken for facts
domed tanks and housings could read as generic, not clearly PP
table cells dense with mixed sans and mono stacks
brand_fit_why: Limestone, navy, steel-blue pipes, light headline, mono codes, hairline isometric art and square corners match the brand book closely.
